title: Normal Human Body Temperature
text: Average human body temperature is often cited as approximately 37 degrees Celsius (98.6 F), though normal ranges vary by individual, time of day, and measurement method, generally falling between about 36.1C and 37.2C (97F-99F). A fever is generally defined as a temperature above 38C (100.4F) and can indicate the body is fighting an infection. Persistent or very high fevers warrant medical evaluation.
